description: Predicción de peligro de aludes is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Generalitat de Catalunya. En el Butlletí de Perill d'Allaus (BPA) s'informa del grau de perill previst en les immediates 24 hores per a 7 zones diferents, de la distribució i l'estat del mantell nival, de la tendència per a les properes 48 i 72 hores. Coverage: Generalitat de Catalunya. The portal shows the English title as "Avalanche risk forecast" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Generalitat de Catalunya. Its keywords include medi ambient, meteorologia, ods13_acció pel clima. The listing shows 1 download or service links in HTML. The listing shows 2025-09-22 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://administraciodigital.gencat.cat/ca/dades/dades-obertes/informacio-practica/llicencies/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
